label: DB 8 × 4
description: A double-breasted waistcoat with eight buttons of which four fasten, the most ornate and formal DB stance with two full rows down the front. The dense buttoning and broad overlap create a commanding, ceremonial look favored by English clothiers, often paired with shawl or peak lapels. It is a staple of Ascot and morning-dress dressing.
